tldr: 台股上一交易日大漲538點至47,718點新高，台積電走穩、三大法人買超470億，外資動向仍是後市關鍵。
台積電CoWoS先進封裝供不應求延續至2027年底，訂單外溢同業，大摩上修輝達、博通產能預估。
金管會強化沉睡帳戶與防詐規範，國銀重兵競逐高資產財管，資產管理規模衝破10兆元。

items.title_zh: 台股大漲538點收47,718 台積電走穩
items.title_en: TAIEX surges 538 points to a record 47,718 as TSMC firms
items.summary_zh: 加權指數上一交易日終場上漲538.09點、漲幅1.14%，收在47,718.84點，成交量8,202億元，權值王台積電上漲20元、漲幅0.81%至2,480元。半導體類股漲1.21%、電子零組件漲3.27%，在AI供應鏈樂觀氣氛與權值股支撐下推升大盤；上漲568家、下跌517家，市場氣氛偏多。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index jumped 538.09 points, or 1.14%, to close at 47,718.84 on turnover of NT$820.2 billion in the latest session, with heavyweight TSMC adding NT$20, or 0.81%, to NT$2,480. Semiconductors rose 1.21% and electronic components climbed 3.27%, as AI-supply-chain optimism and steady index-heavyweight support drove the advance; breadth was positive with 568 gainers against 517 decliners.

items.title_zh: 三大法人買超470億 外資領軍推升大盤
items.title_en: Institutions net buy NT$47 billion, foreign flows lead index higher
items.summary_zh: 三大法人上一交易日合計買超470.37億元，力挺指數大漲，外資及陸資在當日買超排行前20名中扮演要角。法人強勁承接同步支撐電子與金融股，外資買賣超動向仍是左右後市方向的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: The three major institutional investors bought a combined net NT$47.04 billion in the latest session, underpinning the sharp index gain, with foreign and mainland funds featuring prominently in the day's top-20 net-buy list. The strong institutional bid reinforced electronics and financials, keeping foreign positioning the decisive swing factor for the market's next leg.

items.title_zh: 台積電CoWoS供不應求 AI訂單外溢聯電、Amkor
items.title_en: TSMC CoWoS demand outstrips supply, spilling AI orders to UMC and Amkor
items.summary_zh: 台積電先進封裝CoWoS產能持續滿載，月產能預計自2025年底約7萬片擴充至2026年11.5萬片，仍遠不及約百萬片的需求。供給缺口預估延續至2027年底，帶動AI封裝訂單外溢至聯電、Amkor等同業，供應鏈受惠面持續擴大。
items.summary_en: TSMC's advanced-packaging CoWoS capacity remains sold out, with monthly output set to expand from about 70,000 wafers at end-2025 toward 115,000 in 2026 against demand estimated near one million. The persistent shortfall, expected to run into late 2027, is pushing overflow AI-packaging orders to peers such as UMC and Amkor, broadening the supply chain's earnings tailwind.

items.title_zh: 大摩上修台積電CoWoS預估 輝達、博通吃下多數產能
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley lifts TSMC CoWoS forecasts as Nvidia, Broadcom soak up capacity
items.summary_zh: 大摩將輝達2026年CoWoS-L需求由59萬片上修至70萬片，並因Google TPU需求增加彌補Meta ASIC調整，將博通CoWoS-S訂單上修至20萬片。摩根士丹利點名六檔台股科技股為2026年封裝擴產主要受惠標的，凸顯AI加速器需求持續向台積電供應鏈集中。
items.summary_en: Morgan Stanley raised Nvidia's 2026 CoWoS-L demand estimate to 700,000 wafers from 590,000 and lifted Broadcom's CoWoS-S order outlook to 200,000 as Google TPU demand offsets Meta ASIC adjustments. The brokerage flagged six Taiwan tech names as prime beneficiaries of the 2026 packaging build-out, underscoring how AI accelerator demand keeps concentrating in the TSMC-anchored chain.

items.title_zh: 金管會強化沉睡帳戶控管 深化金融聯防防詐
items.title_en: Regulators tighten dormant-account rules in anti-fraud drive
items.summary_zh: 銀行局於8月底修正「存款帳戶及疑似不法或異常交易管理辦法」，並舉辦金融與警政聯防防詐峰會，遏止詐騙集團利用人頭帳戶洗錢。各銀行配合更嚴格的規範調整作業，反映主管機關持續強化帳戶監控與存戶保護的政策方向。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Banking Bureau revised its regulations on deposit accounts and suspected illicit or abnormal transactions in late August, part of a finance-police joint summit to curb fraud rings' use of "ghost accounts" for money laundering. Banks are aligning with the tighter framework, reflecting regulators' continued push to strengthen account monitoring and depositor protection across the system.

items.title_zh: 玉山銀沉睡帳戶新制9/1上路 提領轉帳大縮水
items.title_en: E.Sun Bank curbs long-idle low-balance accounts from Sept 1
items.summary_zh: 玉山銀行9月1日起實施新規，針對逾3年未動用且餘額低於1萬元的帳戶限縮交易功能，ATM每日提領與轉帳上限降至2萬元。此舉呼應全體銀行業配合主管機關防詐指引的緊縮趨勢，封堵遭詐騙集團利用的金流管道。
items.summary_en: E.Sun Bank rolled out new controls on September 1 restricting transaction functions for accounts inactive for over three years with balances under NT$10,000, cutting ATM daily withdrawal and transfer limits to NT$20,000. The move mirrors an industry-wide tightening as lenders act on regulators' anti-fraud guidance to shut down channels exploited by scam networks.

items.title_zh: 國銀重兵競逐高資產 財管規模衝破10兆
items.title_en: Banks pile into high-net-worth race as wealth pool swells past NT$10tn
items.summary_zh: 在亞洲資產管理中心政策推動下，國銀資產管理規模已增逾10兆元，超出兩年目標逾一倍；銀行財管2.0高資產業務規模約2.7兆元、客戶數約2.5萬人。各銀行集結重兵，聚焦私人銀行、家族辦公室與海外資產管理平台（OAMU）三大核心業務，搶攻高資產財富管理商機。
items.summary_en: Under the Asia Asset Management Center initiative, Taiwanese financial institutions' asset-management scale has expanded by more than NT$10 trillion, more than double the two-year target, with bank wealth-management 2.0 high-net-worth business reaching about NT$2.7 trillion across roughly 25,000 clients. Lenders are massing resources around private banking, family offices and overseas asset-management platforms.

items.title_zh: 玉山×KPMG調研 揭高資產傳承布局重點
items.title_en: E.Sun–KPMG survey maps high-net-worth wealth transfer priorities
items.summary_zh: 玉山銀行與KPMG Taiwan合作的2026臺灣高資產顧客財富管理與傳承調研報告指出，家族企業接班與傳承規劃為高資產客戶首要課題，涵蓋信託、結構型商品、基金與保險等工具。結果凸顯富裕家庭在世代交棒、海外資產與多元商品配置需求下，對整合型顧問服務的依賴日增。
items.summary_en: A joint E.Sun Bank and KPMG Taiwan 2026 survey of high-net-worth clients highlights family-business succession and legacy planning as top priorities, spanning trusts, structured products, funds and insurance. The findings underscore rising demand for integrated advisory as affluent families navigate generational transfer, cross-border assets and diversified product allocation amid buoyant markets.
